bullets.text: In Chennai, overnight heavy rains caused severe waterlogging in residential areas and at the Velachery checkpost bus station, prompting school holidays.
Near Puzhal Lake, the bodies of two 14-year-old schoolboys who drowned while swimming were recovered by authorities on Monday afternoon.
In Poonamallee, a sudden hut fire resulted in the tragic death of seventy-four animals, including livestock and poultry, requiring local administrative watch.
The state government has invited tenders for the crucial clearance and restoration of the Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham waterways.
Residents near Puzhuthivakkam face detours because one MRTS station entrance has remained closed since its March inauguration, needing monitoring.
Water inflow into major reservoirs like Puzhal and Poondi has increased significantly due to ongoing heavy rains across the region.
Commuters at the temporary Avadi bus terminus face severe hardships due to poor civic amenities during ongoing CMDA construction work.
In Sriperumbudur, local police successfully traced a missing eight-year-old girl from Karumangazhani village to a children’s home in Kellys.
Chennai Mayor Priya condemned malicious AI-generated videos targeting her on social media and urged police action on pending complaints.
Indian states compete for data center investments as power-ready land replaces traditional tax breaks as the new industry currency.
Artificial intelligence is transforming flavour development, with Chennai emerging as a key hub for accelerated food product innovation.
Equinix India announced plans to expand its domestic data centre operational capacity with a strategic eye on reaching 70 MW.
